arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs x 1250 m out-and-back, current+wind flips each leg. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (~160-165 W pod; CP pod 158 W test, may be 10-25% off), a little harder on adverse legs, easier on helping legs. Use POD reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) as main gauge. Settle the hard start now. Mid-race: check CP by heart-rate trend at steady effort (measure). Final push from ~1000 m if reserve allows (finish cue ~600-800 m). Watch for incidents: drag change (weed: clear_rudder), pod drift (shaft vs boat power diverge), radio messages (course change: set_race_distance + tell).

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs x 1250 m. ODD legs out = current helps (+0.31 m/s), EVEN legs back = adverse; finish on adverse leg 8. Pod reserve was 29 pct at 11.7 min (after hard start). Leg plan by pod power: helping legs ~148 W (ground pace ~149 s/500), adverse legs ~166 W (ground ~175 s/500) - net reserve ~0 per pair, keep the rest for the finish. Cue ease/push with a ground pace target at each turn (target is chased through turns, so re-cue at every turn). Use POD reserve; boat-computer reserve is wrong (read 0 after start). CP check: HR trend on helping leg at ~148 W vs +0.6 bpm/min at 172 W. Final push from ~800-1000 m if pod reserve allows. Incidents: drag (weed: clear_rudder), pod drift, radio course change (set_race_distance + tell).
